title: Guatemalan Civil War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Guatemalan Civil War", at revision 1380106323, opens: "The Guatemalan Civil War Spainsh Guerra civil de Guatemala was fought from 1960 to 1996 between the government of Guatemala and various leftist rebel groups. The Guatemalan government forces committed genocide against the Maya population of Guatemala during the civil war and there were widespread human rights violations against civilians. The context of the struggle was based on longstanding issues over land distribution. Wealthy Guatemalans, mainly of European descent, and foreign companies like the American United Fruit Company had control over much of the land leading to conflicts with the rural, disproportionately indigenous, peasants who worked the land." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1282732, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1960–1996 civil war in Guatemala". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
